aggregation: Equal observations per symbol/week, equal2weeks/block, equal6symbols/context; all joint supported calendar blocks kept. M5 clocks not independent units.
clock: Every completed M5 eligible clock. CSV time_utc start, close available+300sec. Detector walks in chronology without rewind. Own1h control requires13 contiguous completed closes; response retention uses future timestamp membership only before opening. No interpolation, filling or gap crossing.
closure: Support fail DATA_LIMITED_UNTESTED_NOT_NULL; sequential/inference error-control failure CALIBRATION_UNCERTIFIED_UNTESTED_NOT_NULL; power failure LOW_POWER_INCONCLUSIVE_NO_RESPONSE. No real lead NO_REPLICATED_INFORMATION_LEAD_SMALL_EFFECTS_LOW_POWER_INCONCLUSIVE. Exact law only, broad regime/change family remains open. No rescue or next wave in task.

detector.evaluation_initialization: Reset both evidence counters exactly at first evaluation clock, preserve causal previous return; no carry of prefix evidence into development. Gap resets remain mandatory.
detector.normalization: First4-week prefix only: fixed AR1 OLS intercept,phi clipped[-.95,.95], innovation RMS; hourly return RMS on exact contiguous prefix hours. All parameters fixed before any detector state used for second prefix/evaluation.
detector.representation: Causal sequential reflected evidence with adaptive start/reset, available on every eligible completed M5 clock, not binary alarm trigger, not retrospective breakpoint or ER router.
detector.threshold_justification: h=log(2directions*18symbols*maximum84672candidate change starts/.01), fixed union-bound reference for bounded zero-conditional-mean increments via Hoeffding supermartingale. Prefix parameter estimation/dependence make assumptions non-exact; synthetic calibration is mandatory, no universal finite-sample guarantee.
detector.update: u=clip((r_t-prefix_intercept-prefix_phi*r_t-1)/prefix_sigma,-1,1); Cplus=max(0,Cplus+bet*u-bet^2/2), Cminus=max(0,Cminus-bet*u-bet^2/2); dense state=(Cplus-Cminus)/h. Alarm if either accumulator>=h; emit state then reset both for next completed bar. Reset on any missing300sec link.

distinctness: No efficiency ratio, no ER trend/range router, no breakpoint retrospectively fitted, no sparse z trigger, no realized-variance concentration, no factor/basket residual, no sign-only multiscale alignment rescue. Fixed hour return only baseline, sequential adaptive memory is tested information.
economic_boundary: COST_UNRESOLVED; before promotion require authentic conservative spread,commission,slippage,size,margin,EURconversion. No zero costs assumed. HARD21 only final portfolio certification.
execution_translation: Later completed-M5 single-leg own-instrument side=sign(theta*x_residual), fixed1h exit and conservative position-overlap/risk/sizing policy, CSharp implementation stores2counters, previousreturn,12close queue and prefix constants. No multi-leg hedge.
independent_unit: Two-week shared context vector, short-memory approximately stationary score assumption; HAC2, explicitly conditional finite-stress calibration.

inference.family: all3 contexts,1 own-instrument horizon,both signs; conservative fixed cutoff, no analytical pvalue claim
inference.mc_rule: Every32 full-family synthetic null upper simultaneous Wilson<=.05; Bonferroni confidence allocation, finite stress grid not arbitrary dependence proof. Trial count fixed before any simulations.
inference.power_law: Complete significance, same direction3contexts, same direction3calendar thirds,4of6assets each context. Weakest18block geometry. Power in two-week score SD, never bps; smaller effects low-power/inconclusive.
inference.statistic: mean/HAC Bartlett lag2 SE over shared two-week vectors

prior_exposure: Reused development prices are historically exposed, not untouched confirmation. Prospective mechanism selection excludes leaf outcomes. Disjoint confirmation required later and unauthorized.
replication: Same nonzero direction and absoluteT>=5 in all3contexts, same sign in all3fixed thirds(block//7), >=4of6assets per context. No pooling or best symbol/context substitute.
response: x_residual*(own next1h cumulative log return/prefix hour RMS - frozen prefix baseline_y). Direct signed own-instrument information; incremental relative to current innovation/fixed-hour carrier/UTC baseline, not all possible models. Both theta signs are one frozen family.
scope: All18 already accepted development series across3 fixed six-member economic contexts, no prior variance/factor counts or outcomes used for membership. Not a1576-universe coverage claim.

sequential_calibration.change_rule: Sustained signed conditional innovation mean change; magnitude in prefix innovation SD. Both change signs tested via identical detector; wrong-direction first alarms count failure. Deadline1008M5 clocks=84h. Report10/50/90delay quantiles and censoring; smaller shifts LOW_POWER, no economic translation. Future raw AR returns receive the prospectively fixed conditional-innovation mean step; use actual fitted prefix intercept,phi,sigma including estimation error; common noise across effect/sign alternatives.
sequential_calibration.dependence_generation: AR1/AR2 finite128 impulse response FFT linear convolution, burn128; truncation negligible for declared stable coefficients. prefix AR1 estimation identical OLS law, bounded innovation, whole future path first-passage over CUSUM drawup; no alarm reset needed before first alarm. No-gaps worst calendar continuity.
sequential_calibration.gate: For every6 stress cases,18*single-stream full84672clock first-alarm Wilson upper<=.05. Union bound does not assume independence between assets. Trials4096 fixed from required per-stream ceiling. No precision extension, seed rerun or threshold adjustment after calibration.

training: Second disjoint4-week prefix after normalization: OLS raw dense signed detector state on controls[1,current clipped innovation,clip(completed-hour ownreturn/prefix hour RMS,-4,4),sinUTCday,cosUTCday]; residual state divided by second-prefix RMS. Fit future own1h normalized return on same controls using prefix-contained future values only. No development fitting. Prefix ends before development with >1h purge.
